funds.name: Open Drive
funds.thesis: When a volatile stock moves overnight, the move tends to carry on through the New York session.
funds.rules: Each weekday at 10:00 New York time, take the side of each volatile stock's overnight move, equal shares adding to the fund, and close everything at 16:00.

funds.name: Daily Reversal
funds.thesis: Yesterday's biggest movers among large stocks tend to give some of it back the next day.
funds.rules: Each day at midnight UTC, buy the eight stocks that fell most over the last day and short the eight that rose most, half the fund on each side.

funds.name: Oil Breakout
funds.thesis: Oil moves in shocks. When it breaks out of its range it tends to keep going.
funds.rules: Every four hours, go with WTI or Brent when it closes beyond its 20-bar high or low, and leave when it crosses back past its 10-bar extreme.

funds.name: Chip Rotation
funds.thesis: Money rotates between the AI chip and memory names; the leaders of the last week tend to lead the next.
funds.rules: Each day, hold the two chip stocks with the best five-day return, half the fund in each.

funds.name: DeepSeek Macro
funds.thesis: An open model reads gold, oil, the indices, bitcoin and two big stocks every hour and trades what it sees.
funds.rules: Each hour the model sets the fund's shares across eight markets, at most twice the fund in all.

strategy.mandate: Grow the fund steadily across macro markets. Avoid large losses. Trade only when you see a reason.

funds.name: All Weather
funds.thesis: Stocks, gold and bitcoin rarely all fall at once. Holding all three and putting them back in balance compounds.
funds.rules: Hold the S&P 500 at 40%, the tech 100 at 20%, gold at 30% and bitcoin at 10%, rebalanced daily when a share drifts.

funds.name: Magnificent Seven
funds.thesis: The seven largest technology companies, held in equal shares and owned around the clock.
funds.rules: Hold Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Tesla equally, rebalanced daily when a share drifts.

funds.name: Trend Compounder
funds.thesis: Hold the indices and gold while their long trend is up and step aside when it turns, to keep most of the gain with about half the fall.
funds.rules: Each day, hold the S&P 500, the tech 100 and gold while each one's 50-day average is above its 200-day average, each sized to 15% yearly volatility, at most twice the fund.
